_comment: sample:true = date NOT pañchāṅga-confirmed. Draft builds show these flagged; --production excludes them (the wheel degrades to its confirmation state). Set sample:false only when the founder confirms the tithi/date.

festivals.line: The full moon of the teachers — satsaṅga and sevā.
The Mondays of Śrāvaṇa — rudrābhiṣeka each week of the month.
The serpents of the Lord honoured at the jaladhari.
Nine nights of the Devī — order restored, the tenth day victorious.
A thousand dīpas on the parikramā — the mandir kept in flame.
Dev Dīpāvalī — the gods' own festival of lamps closes the season.
The sun turns north — uttarāyaṇa begins at the mandir.
The great night of Śiva — the mandir's highest utsava, jāgaraṇa till dawn.
